sections.title: Eight blocks
lines: Bottom pad row = the eight blocks.

HOLD a pad to edit it.

sections.title: Splitting the board
lines: The row ABOVE the blocks. Dark
TAP a DARK pad   part here
TAP a LIT pad    other side
Once split the boxes move: the
LEFT lane sits up, the RIGHT
sits down. You see two paths.
The header names the block, the
side you are on, and what it is.
BYP in a box = bypassed, which
is why it makes no sound.
